latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Message Clinic Runner — an end-to-end workflow for turning draft messages into sticky, memorable communications based on the Made to Stick SUCCESs framework.

- Runs a full "Idea Clinic" process: SITUATION, original MESSAGE, DIAGNOSIS (via SUCCESs audit), revised MESSAGE, and PUNCH LINE summary.
- Orchestrates targeted rewrites for weak SUCCESs dimensions using foundation skills (concreteness, emotional appeal, evidence, story, etc.).
- Preserves user’s tone, brand, and legal constraints; never invents facts or testimonials.
- Handles “already sticky” drafts by returning a no-rework verdict and clear rationale.
- Excludes multi-message campaigns and diagnosis-only requests; designed strictly for single-draft, end-to-end makeovers.
